description: Returns the latest AI-written summary of one server's logs and its five most frequent log patterns from the last hour (nginx, Apache, Laravel, Docker, PM2, systemd), with counts and when each was last seen.
name: get_log_summary

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

summary.description: Latest AI-written summary, or null when none has been generated.
Plain-English summary of the last hour of logs.

top_issues.description: Most important issues named in the summary.

top_clusters.description: Five most frequent log patterns from the last hour.

representative_message.description: Normalised example line for the pattern.

source.description: Log source: nginx, apache, laravel, docker, pm2, systemd.

title: Log summary
